decisions.1_rook_join: DEFAULT (team vote pending): Rook already joined Junior Bright right after Fernbrook (MAPS_SLICE teaser / Route 2). Here he is made official (lanyard) instead of signing up; STORY row 2 reads this way until the vote.
decisions.2_rook_battle: Rook battle #2 is scripted inside the quarry buyout (oneShot, sight 0); win or lose, the story goes on.
decisions.3_paragon: Not decided here. No line names or hints at the Paragon; Ilse and Oriel are not mentioned.
decisions.4_scope: Episode 1 only. No Act 2+ systems: the Seal grants no field skill; nothing reads Calm Towers or weather.
decisions.5_end: Cobblecrest ends at the locked Brinewick road with a COMING LATER card (story.cobble_end).

replaceObjs.text: COBBLECREST QUARRY ROAD · Closed for upgrades. Thank you for your patience! — Glimmerwell Co.

addObjs.text: COBBLECREST · Quarry town, just ahead. Today: QUARRY OPEN HOUSE! — Glimmerwell Co.

route2_end: Locked. 'Closed for upgrades.' Since when does a quarry need upgrades?
Master Hale's Trial Hall is up there. He dug with his Walklings, not with lamps.
Clunk! The gate swings open. A banner unrolls: QUARRY OPEN HOUSE · TODAY ONLY!
Open house? Perfect. My supervisor's up there. He'll explain everything.
Together. But I'm still beating you to the Seal.

objs.deny: The door is latched. A chalk note: 'At the quarry meeting. — Hale'

objs.text: COBBLECREST · A quarry town. Please mind the Pebblits underfoot.
COBBLECREST TRIAL HALL · Master Hale · STONE · "Stone stands firm."
NORTH · Cobblecrest Quarry. OPEN HOUSE TODAY! Free brochures. — Glimmerwell Co.
NORTH · Bright Quarry, a Glimmerwell Co. site. Brighter by nature.
BRINEWICK ROAD · Closed while crates are loaded. Thank you for your patience! — Glimmerwell Co.

lines.else: Glimmerwell crates, stacked high. Every one is stencilled BRINEWICK DOCKS.

lines.story.seal2: The Miners' Cairn. Someone has tucked a tiny new cobble on top. It looks like yours.
lines.else: The Miners' Cairn. Each miner adds one cobble when they retire. Hale's is near the top.
Jars of snacks and a tin marked ACORNS, PLEASE.
A chalkboard: CAIRNSIDE SUPPLIES · Snacks for the road.
Welcome to Cairnside Supplies! Snacks for the road, dear.

lines.story.seal2: Hale says you moved stone the right way. Patient. That's high praise from him.
lines.story.quarry_bought: Sold, just like that. The Pebblits in the Old Seam won't understand a fence.
lines.else: Forty years Hale and I dug side by side. The Pebblits always showed us where to swing.

lines.story.quarry_bought: Mum voted no. She says glow should stay in the ground where it's comfy.
lines.else: Glimmerwell gave out free lamp stickers! I put one on my Pebblit. It sneezed.

lines.story.seal2: A Seal from Hale! He doesn't hand those out to just anyone. Well done.
lines.else: The vote passed fair and square. I only wish it felt fair.
FRIEND SLOT · Ally A says hi! (One short line, written with the friend.)

objs.text: OLD SEAM · Shh. Pebblits napping. Tread softly. — Cobblecrest Miners

lines.else: A shiny gate bolted across the Old Seam. A plaque: GLOW SEAM · ASSOCIATES ONLY.

lines.story.seal2: Hale's Seal, huh? Doesn't open this gate, sorry. Nothing does. Have a bright day!
lines.else: Associates only past the gate. It's for the Pebblits' safety! Says so on the memo.
Bunting in Glimmerwell mint and white. It smells like new paint.
A banner: QUARRY OPEN HOUSE · A BRIGHT NEW PARTNERSHIP.

lines.story.quarry_bought: The seam's fenced now. For the Pebblits' safety! ...That's what the memo says.
lines.else: Welcome to the open house! Free brochure: 'Glow, brighter by nature.' Ooh, take a sticker too!
@lantern_rest
@lantern_rest
@lantern_rest
The town lantern. Quarry dust drifts through its glow like tiny stars.
A rack of old miners' lamps, unlit. A tag: 'Retired, like us. — the Miners.'

objs.text: A note pinned by the door: "Rest as long as you like. The quarry's dusty. — Cobblecrest"

lines.else: A brass lantern. Hale keeps it lit for the Pebblits, not for himself.
A little cairn of cobbles, one for every keeper who earned a Seal here.
@seam_b
@seam_a

objs.text: Chalk on the wall: STONE STANDS FIRM. TIDE AND BLOOM SPLIT IT. SPARKS DO NOTHING.

lines.intro: Hold still! I'm sketching the cliffs. Actually, a battle's more fun.
lines.win: You've got a good outline, {player}. Bold lines.
lines.lose: There. Now you're in my sketchbook. Rest up!

lines.intro: Last day cutting stone here, they say. Let's make it a good one!
lines.win: Well laid, {player}. Not a crack in it.
lines.lose: Solid work from my lot. Take a breather.

lines.intro: Stone stands firm! Watch my Walklings dig in and brace.
lines.win: My cairn tumbled! You found the weak spot, {player}.
lines.lose: Steady as a cairn. Rest a while and try again.

lines.intro: Bracing isn't just for stone. Anyone can learn to stand firm!
lines.win: Worn right down. Hale will like you, {player}.
lines.lose: See? Firm as the hill. Come back steadier.

lines.intro: Stone stands firm. Show me how a keeper moves it.
lines.win: Ha! You moved the hill, {player}. Gently, too.
lines.lose: Stone's patient. So am I. Rest, and come back.

lines.intro: Official Junior Bright, official lanyard. Let's see whose glow shines brighter!
lines.lose: Ha! Junior Bright training works. Told you!

cobble_arrive: Ha! Beat you here! ...By about four seconds. Still counts.
See? Together. Now I get to beat you to the Seal, fair and square.
{name}! You made it. Welcome to Cobblecrest!
The open house is up at the quarry. My supervisor's giving a speech!
Lantern House is right here, by the way. Rest up first. Trust me.
The Lantern House glows by the road. If your team ever tires, you'll wake up here now.
quarry_buyout: A crowd fills the quarry floor. Mint-and-white bunting flaps over a little stage.
Friends of Cobblecrest! Dorian Pell, Head of Acquisitions. What a quarry! What potential!
Deep in your Old Seam sleeps pure glow. Let's bring it into the light. Together!
The town voted last night. The quarry is sold to Glimmerwell Co. It passed by three votes.
Pebblits have napped in that seam since before my grandad was born. Where do they go?
Somewhere comfy, Master Hale! Every unit gets a lovely new home. It's a partnership!
Associates roll crates toward the Old Seam. Somewhere in the rock, a soft rumble goes quiet.
Delivery! Twelve Comfort Lamps for the seam, sir!
Our star Junior Bright! Your official lanyard, as promised. Welcome aboard for real, Rook.
Thanks, sir! Um. The Walklings under the Wickerglen lamps looked... drained.
Tired is just relaxed with bad lighting, Rook. Now, who's your friend?
Passion! I love it. Glimmerwell loves Pebblits too. Very, very much.
Just a friend of progress. And a friend of yours, I hope.
Rook, show {name} what Junior Bright training looks like. Friendly, of course!
You heard him! Our race to the Seal starts right here.
You're good. Really good. Was my training... wrong?
See? The training works! ...It does. Right?
Splendid show, both of you! Paperwork waits for no one. Have a bright day!
Dorian strolls off. The Associates bolt a shiny gate across the Old Seam.
He called the Pebblits units. ...He'll explain later. He always explains.
My Trial Hall's open, {name}. Come show me how a keeper moves stone.
seam_a: A seam stone blocks the way. Chalk on its face asks: WHAT SPLITS STONE?
Water finds a crack and the stone rolls aside. TIDE moves hit STONE twice as hard!
A root-crack splits it wide and it rolls aside. BLOOM moves hit STONE twice as hard!
Nothing happens. Stone doesn't mind sparks at all: VOLT moves can't touch STONE.
seam_b: Another seam stone. Chalk: A BRACED STONE STANDS FIRMER. HOW DO YOU MOVE IT?
You shove. It doesn't budge. While it stays braced, plain force barely dents it.
A sharp tap on the weak side and it rolls away. Type beats a brace!
Bit by bit the brace gives. Lower its DEF or raise your ATK to move braced stone.
hale_trial: Stone's patient, {name}. Visit whenever you like. The kettle's always on.
Forty years I dug beside Walklings. Never once with a lamp.
Stone stands firm. Show me how you'd move it.
seal2: That's the Cobblecrest Seal. Carry it steady, like a good stone.
A Wake Tonic, too. For the day a friend needs picking up off the ground.
Next Hall's Brinewick, down on the coast. Marisol runs it. Tell her old Hale says hello.
brinewick_hook: A Glimmerwell cart rattles down from the quarry, piled high with crates.
{name}! I'm riding with the cart to Brinewick. Dorian says it's routine.
One crate is stencilled BRINEWICK DOCKS. It hums, very softly, like something asleep.
If it's routine... why does it hum? Never mind. See you on the road!
COMING LATER · Brinewick and its Trial Hall. Thanks for playing Cobblecrest!
